caption: The drawing shows a single object, specifically a bellows, which is centered within a rectangular border on a beige background. The bellows is teardrop-shaped with a tapered, metallic nozzle at the left end, painted in gold and brown tones with a few circular accents. The main body consists of two wooden panels, colored in light tan and brown shades, joined by a leather or flexible material in darker brown. The surface of the bellows is decorated with a floral and leaf pattern, featuring red and pink flowers, green leaves, and a large red and green central fruit or flower, all outlined with brown. Two wooden handles in brown extend to the right. The image is a color drawing with distinct outlines and moderate shading to suggest three-dimensional form, and no other objects appear in the composition.
title: Bellows
